reuse.why: Uses the small existing helpers (assertBankAccountNotLinked, findOrCreateBank, handleSyncResponse, syncAccount) but writes a new generic linkBankSyncAccount from the existing linker bodies that only Fintegra calls, and copies the Akahu download function instead of sharing it.

duplication.why: linkBankSyncAccount repeats the upgrade-or-create/insert payee/initial sync/notify block that the five other linkers still carry, and downloadFintegraTransactions repeats the Akahu/EnableBanking download body.

placement.why: Linker in accounts/app.ts, downloader and dispatch in accounts/sync.ts, URL in server-config.ts and type in types/models, as for the other providers.

scope.why: Mostly focused, but it widens assertBankAccountNotLinked's provider type from AccountSyncSource to string, an unrelated loosening of an existing contract.

maintainability.why: Leaves the codebase with a half-applied abstraction (a generic link helper used by one provider beside five hand-written copies), and Fintegra is never added to the BankSyncProviders/AccountSyncSource union, so the type safety the tree had is lost.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked and linkBankSyncAccount in accounts/app.ts take provider: string instead of extending the AccountSyncSource/BankSyncProviders type the tree uses for sync sources.

disguised_duplication.where: linkBankSyncAccount (accounts/app.ts) is the existing linkers' body renamed into a generic-looking helper that none of them call, so the copy is presented as shared code.
